attempts.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc and a systemd service inventory-worker on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker under that account, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence sequence: captured baseline boot ID and service health, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified the service came back enabled/active running as inventorysvc after reboot.
